title: The Van You Cannot See
hook: A white van sits in the right mirror.
scene: Clear cold afternoon on West Valley. You signaled left a breath ago. In the right side mirror, a white panel van sits in the blind spot the Ledger cannot see from the seat — close, same heading, no lamps. If you drift right to make the left feel bigger, you write him into the side of the bus. The blinker is already talking.
decision: The right mirror has a van in the blind spot and you are mid-change. What do you do?

options.text: Cancel, hold the lane, let him show or fall back, then take a clean gap
options.result: You kill the blinker and hold. He appears in the inside mirror a second later, then drops. The next gap is empty. You take it without writing him into the steel.

options.text: Finish the left — he is on the right, so the left is yours
options.result: You commit left. The van was using you as a windbreak and comes with you. Steel on steel. He never had lamps. You never had the blind spot clear.

options.text: Drift right first to square up, then take the left
options.result: You drift into the blind spot to get a better angle. The right mirror was already telling you someone was there. The panel takes the side of the bus. That was the timeout.

options.text: Tap the horn so he knows to get out of the mirror
options.result: The horn on Central. He flinches into you. You both stop in a live lane. Everything behind has to lift.

debrief: If you cannot see him in the glass, assume he is in the blind spot. Cancel, hold, then take a gap you have swept. Hold the lane until that van is a van you can see.

source.psdp_skill: Skill nine: multi-lane roads – part one
source.teaching_target: Recheck the blind zone during a lane change; do not drift into a vehicle the side mirror already showed.
